description: Validation benchmark reference directions and expected changes. Literature citations and empirical effect sizes are to be populated by the researcher.

benchmarks.notes: Berger effect: occipital and parietal alpha rhythm markedly increases upon eye closure due to reduction in visual input.
Non-selective adenosine receptor antagonism leads to elevated alertness, higher vigilance, and increases in EEG beta/gamma power.
Adenosine receptor blockade mediates cerebral vasoconstriction, decreasing baseline global cerebral blood flow.
High rate of sensory switching and unpredictable rewards evoke intermittent dopamine surges in the ventral striatum and mesolimbic loop.
A stable resting run with identical seed should exhibit low coefficient of variation (< 5%) across repeated iterations.
